versions.changelog: Provider base class (OpenAICompatibleProvider), typed exceptions (ConfigError/APIError/IOError_), 24 unit tests. 5 platforms, 30+ models. Agent-native output with JSON envelopes, dry-run, schema introspection.

imagenCN 1.0.0

- Initial release of a multi-platform AI image generation tool specializing in Chinese text and photorealistic images
- Supports DashScope (Alibaba), ByteDance Volcano Ark, Tencent Hunyuan, Zhipu BigModel, and StepFun platforms with 30+ models
- Cross-platform: works on Windows, macOS, and Linux
- Interactive workflow guides users from prompt refinement through model/size selection to output
- Built-in reference for comparing all supported models, sizes, and pricing
- Strong focus on accurate Chinese text rendering and advanced image editing features
